recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man in a blazer and jeans standing in a gritty, debris-filled urban alleyway, featuring a prominent horizontal typographic header with a distinct linear transparency effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center against a receding brick and metal background
Typography spanning the top edge, interacting with the subject's head
Contrast between the formal blazer and the industrial, weathered environment
Horizontal stripes in the lettering echoing the linear perspective of the alley
coreInvariants: Subject wearing thick-rimmed glasses and a dark blazer
Heavy, geometric sans-serif typography at the top margin
Multi-line horizontal transparency pattern within the letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-full shot, subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, leaning slightly forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and glasses, framed by the dark hair and the bright typography above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, follows the line of the blazer to the debris on the ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right third of the image is occupied by a weathered door and brickwork, providing environmental context.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (browns, grays, and brick reds) in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and black of the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white and light gray used in the typography and highlights on the subject's face.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark clothing and the light text.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal 'speed lines' or transparent stripes cut through the top half of the glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Glyphs are sliced horizontally with 3-4 parallel lines of varying transparency

treatment.fill: Solid off-white with horizontal stripe masks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying transparency effects for visual interest.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s/80s vibe and heavy weight
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton for modification

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A gritty 1980s urban alleyway with a red brick wall on the left and a weathered wooden door on the right. In the foreground, a man with curly dark hair and thick black glasses, wearing a dark blazer and blue jeans, stands leaning forward. The lighting is overcast and moody.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a single line of extra-bold geometric sans-serif text across the top margin. The text should be off-white and feature 4 horizontal transparent stripes cutting through the top half of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the typography extra-bold and geometric?
Does the text have the horizontal stripe effect?
Is the background a gritty urban alley?
Is the subject wearing a blazer and glasses?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the horizontal stripes in the text
Level of debris in the alleyway
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
Any specific brand logos on the clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is justified to the top edge.
Ensure the horizontal stripes in the font are clean and parallel.
Verify the subject's attire matches the 80s rock aesthetic.
Confirm the background texture feels weathered and authentic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a gritty urban portrait with a heavy geometric header that uses linear masking to create a sense of motion or retro-futurism.
